findings.title: Unescaped embed URL interpolated into raw-HTML post allows stored XSS
findings.description: `TopicEmbed.import` builds `"#{url}"` with no escaping, and the result is stored with `cook_method: raw_html`. `Post#cook` (`app/models/post.rb:133`) returns `raw` verbatim for that method, so the markup is rendered unsanitized. The URL is attacker-controllable end to end: - **Entry:** `EmbedController#best` takes `params[:embed_url]` and enqueues `retrieve_topic` (`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15`). The only gate is the `Referer` header, which any non-browser client can set. - **Host check:** `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` only compares `URI(@embed_url).host`. A URL such as `http:///post.html?'onmouseover='alert(1)` passes, since `'` is legal in a URI. - **Fetch:** most servers return 200 for an unknown query string, so `import_remote` succeeds. - **Result:** the `'` closes the `href` attribute and injects an event handler into a topic on the forum origin. Fix: escape the URL with `ERB::Util.html_escape` (or build the link via Nokogiri), and anchor the scheme check with `\A` rather than `^` on line 11.

findings.title: Remote content is stored and rendered as trusted HTML with no sanitization
findings.description:
- **RSS path:** `poll_feed` passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` straight to `TopicEmbed.import`. There is no whitelist, so `<script>`, `on*` attributes and `javascript:` URLs survive into `cooked`.
- **HTTP path:** `import_remote` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb:48-50`) whitelists tags and attributes via Readability but not URL schemes, so `href="javascript:..."` survives.
- **Edit path:** `PostRevisor` re-saves edited raw for a `raw_html` post through the same no-op `cook`, so anyone who can edit the post can inject script.
- **Display:** both `app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19` (`raw post.cooked`) and the main app render it.

Run imported HTML through the existing sanitizer before storing it.

findings.title: Unauthenticated callers can create unlimited topics and trigger feed polls
findings.description:
- The throttle key is `"retrieved:#{@embed_url}"`, and embeds are keyed on the exact URL string. Varying the query string (`?x=1`, `?x=2`, …) bypasses the throttle and creates a new topic per request under `embed_by_username`.
- Each such request also runs `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously (line 41), re-downloading the whole feed.
- `setnx` followed by `expire` (lines 27-28) is not atomic. A crash between them leaves a key with no TTL, permanently blocking that URL. Use `set(key, 1, nx: true, ex: 60)`.

Normalize the URL (strip query and fragment) and add a global or per-IP limit.

findings.title: Referer is emitted into inline JS in the wrong escaping context and cached across requesters
findings.description:
`'<%= request.referer %>'` is HTML-escaped inside a `<script>` string, where it should be JS-escaped. A Referer ending in `\` escapes the closing quote and breaks the resize script.

`discourse_expires_in 1.minute` (`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:19`) stores the response in `Middleware::AnonymousCache`, whose key is only host plus request URI (`lib/middleware/anonymous_cache.rb:14`). Consequences:
- One requester's Referer-derived body is served to every anonymous viewer for a minute.
- The cached response, including `X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL`, is served without running `ensure_embeddable`, so the referer check is bypassed while the cache is warm.

Emit only the origin, via `to_json`, built from `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`.

findings.title: Protocol-relative and default-port URLs are rewritten incorrectly
findings.description:
- `href.start_with?('/')` also matches `//cdn.example.com/a.png`. `sub(/^\/+/, '')` then yields `http://host/cdn.example.com/a.png`, breaking CDN images and links.
- The port check `uri.port != 80 && uri.port != 443` ignores the scheme, so `http://host:443` and `https://host:80` lose their port. Compare against `uri.default_port`.
- Path-relative URLs such as `images/a.png` are not handled.
- The `a` and `img` loops are duplicates.

`URI.join(url, href)` would handle all of these.

findings.title: `import` mutates its argument and mishandles failed creates and deleted posts
findings.description:
- **Line 13:** `contents << ...` mutates the caller's string, which raises on frozen input.
- **Lines 23-24:** `PostCreator#create` returns an unsaved `Post` when it rolls back (`lib/post_creator.rb:222-236`). `post.present?` is still true, so `TopicEmbed.create!` runs with nil ids and raises. Check `post.persisted?` or the errors instead.
- **Lines 32-36:** `Post` uses a `Trashable` default scope, so `embed.post` is nil once the imported post is deleted. `PostRevisor.new(nil).revise!` then raises `NoMethodError` when the content changes.
- **Deleted topics:** no code removes the `topic_embeds` row when its topic is deleted, so `topic_id_for_embed` keeps returning the dead topic id.

findings.title: Feed polling aborts on one bad item and uses `Kernel#open` on configurable input
findings.description:
- `i.content.scrub` raises `NoMethodError` for items with only `<description>`.
- Any exception from `TopicEmbed.import` on one item stops the remaining items. With `retry: false` nothing is logged per item.
- `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` here, `open(url)` in `import_remote` (`app/models/topic_embed.rb:48`), and the Disqus task's `t[:link]` all use `Kernel#open`. That executes a command for values starting with `|`, reads local paths, has no timeout or size limit, and follows redirects.

Use `Net::HTTP` or `URI.parse(...).open` after validating the scheme.

findings.title: Stray `if` after `end` in the embed template
findings.description: `<%- end if %>` leaves a dangling modifier-`if`. Depending on how Erubis joins the statement, it is either a syntax error or silently uses the next output-buffer append as the condition. Either way it should be `<%- end %>`. No spec renders this view, so it is unexercised.

findings.title: Disqus import loses category and created_at, and now needs a live fetch per thread
findings.description:
- The `--category` option and the `created_at:` argument were removed, so imported topics are uncategorized and dated at import time.
- `TopicEmbed.import_remote` makes an HTTP request per thread. A single dead link raises `OpenURI::HTTPError` and aborts the whole import.

findings.title: Existing migration edited and `force: true` added to table creation
findings.description:
An already-shipped migration is modified to `create_table :top_topics, force: true`, and the new `topic_embeds` migration (`db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3`) uses it too. `force: true` silently drops an existing table and its data.

`db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb` is also touched with whitespace-only changes. Historical migrations should be left immutable.

findings.title: New gems are missing from two of the three lock files
findings.description: `ruby-readability` and `simple-rss` appear in `Gemfile_rails4.lock` but not in `Gemfile.lock` or `Gemfile_rails_master.lock`. A frozen `bundle install` on the default lock fails, and the lazy `require` calls then raise at runtime.

findings.title: Tests miss the critical paths and some pass for the wrong reason
findings.description:
- **Vacuous guards:** "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" each stub only one setting. `feed_polling_enabled` defaults to false (`config/site_settings.yml:355`), so `execute` short-circuits before the stubbed guard is reached.
- **Copy-paste:** the `require_dependency 'jobs/regular/process_post'` on line 2 is unrelated.
- **Untested code:** `PollFeed#poll_feed`, `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, `Jobs::RetrieveTopic`, `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, `#retrieved_recently?`, and the `skip_validations` path in `PostRevisor`.
- **Thin assertions:** `absolutize_urls` has no port or protocol-relative cases, and the update test in `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:39-42` only regex-matches `cooked`.
- **Views never rendered:** `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:48-52` stubs `TopicView.new` to return nil and does not render views, so the templates never run.

findings.title: Weak origin check and missing guards in embed.js
findings.description: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` is a substring test, so a prefix origin such as `https://forum.example.co` passes for `https://forum.example.com/`. Impact is limited to setting the iframe height. Compare against the exact origin instead. The script also assumes `discourseUrl` ends in `/` and that `#discourse-comments` exists.

findings.title: Dead code and incorrect requires
findings.description:
- `feed_key` and the `digest/sha1` require in `poll_feed.rb` are unused.
- `require_dependency 'email/sender'` in `app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:1` is unrelated.
- `require_dependency 'nokogiri'` in `app/models/topic_embed.rb:1` should be a plain `require`.
- `topic_embed.rb` uses `open` without requiring `open-uri`, relying on other files having loaded it.
- The lookup `User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` is duplicated in `poll_feed.rb:25` and `lib/topic_retriever.rb:49`. The latter raises on a nil setting.

findings.title: `cook_method` is not exposed to API callers
findings.description: `PostsController#create_params` (`app/controllers/posts_controller.rb:227-253`) does not permit `cook_method`, so regular or API users cannot request raw-HTML cooking. The first post is excluded from the embed view by `post_number > 1` in `lib/filter_best_posts.rb:37`, so the imported article is not echoed under itself.
